name: report_progress
label: Report Progress
description: Report your current task progress as a percentage (0-100). Call this whenever you make meaningful progress on your task.

message.description: Brief status message describing what you are doing

name: complete_task
label: Complete Task
description: Mark a task as completed with final deliverables. Workers call this when their assigned task is done. Lead calls this for parent tasks when all children are done.

deliverable.description: Final deliverable: code, analysis result, document content, etc.

task_id.description: Task ID to complete. If omitted, completes your current assigned task.

name: dispatch_task
label: Dispatch Task
description: (Lead only) Create a subtask under a submitted parent task and assign it to a worker. Always provide parent_task_id so the parent task tracks completion. Always state route_reason: why THIS agent (specialty fit / shortest queue / past success evidence from the member capability table) — it is kept on the task as an auditable routing decision.

assignee_id.description: ID of the worker agent to assign this task to

route_reason.description: Why this agent was chosen (specialty fit / load / past success evidence) — one short line, kept as the auditable routing decision

parent_task_id.description: The ID of the submitted parent task this subtask belongs to (from the task list)

name: send_message_to_agent
label: Send Message
description: Send a message to another agent (lead or worker) in the same channel via the channel mailbox (routed to the recipient's own mailbox). Use priority "immediate" for urgent real-time messages that the recipient sees instantly during work; use "task" (default) for messages that queue until the recipient finishes their current task. Set require_reply=true to demand a response: the recipient must reply with their result via this same tool. When replying to a message, pass its message_id as in_reply_to — replies are auto-upgraded to real-time delivery and pushed straight into the recipient's running session, so the answer reaches a waiting sender instantly.

message.description: Message content (when replying: your execution result + the content they asked for)

priority.description: Message priority: "immediate" = inject into recipient's running session instantly; "task" = queue for later consumption (default)

require_reply.description: Trigger: true = recipient MUST reply with result/content (default false)

in_reply_to.description: Message ID this reply refers to (set when replying to a trigger message)

name: poll_messages
label: Poll Inbox
description: Check your own mailbox for unread messages from other agents. When waiting for a reply, pass wait_seconds (e.g. 90) to block until it arrives or the wait expires — one blocking call replaces repeated empty polling. Returned collaboration messages are acknowledged on read (removed from the queue); task assignments are left for execution. Replies to your trigger messages are also pushed into your running session in real time — if you already saw an injected "[实时消息 from X]", that IS the reply, no need to poll again.

wait_seconds.description: Block up to N seconds (0-180) waiting for a message before returning empty (default 0 = immediate check)

name: read_channel_mail
label: Read Channel Mail
description: (Lead only) Read the FULL channel mail log: every message routed through the channel mailbox (peer messages, real-time replies with in_reply_to chains, and task deliveries), newest first, with read/unread state. Pass agent_id to inspect a specific member's mailbox. Use this BEFORE dispatching a task whose result may already exist — if a worker already computed/delivered the value via mail, do NOT re-dispatch it; reference the concrete result from the mail instead.

agent_id.description: Optional: only show mails involving this agent (as sender or recipient)

name: broadcast_message
label: Broadcast
description: Broadcast a message to ALL agents in the channel (lead + all workers). Useful for announcements.

name: list_channel_tasks
label: List Tasks
description: List all tasks in the current channel, including their status, progress, and assignee.

name: list_team_agents
label: List Team
description: List all agents in the current channel (lead + workers) with their roles and names.

name: get_task_details
label: Get Task
description: Get detailed information about a specific task, including artifacts and history.

name: get_my_task_queue
label: My Queue
description: View your own task queue: pending tasks (FIFO order), the task you are currently executing, and completed tasks. Use this to check if you have unfinished work.

name: get_queue_overview
label: Queue Overview
description: (Lead only) Real-time overview of every team member: status (idle/busy), current task, pending queue length, completed count. Use this to make optimal scheduling and rebalancing decisions.

name: reassign_task
label: Reassign Task
description: (Lead only) Move a pending (not yet started) or failed task from one worker to another. Use for load rebalancing or when a worker is stuck. The old worker's queued delivery is revoked automatically.

to_agent_id.description: Worker agent ID to receive the task

name: update_task
label: Update Task
description: (Lead only) Modify the title/description of a pending (queued, not started) task. The assignee's queued delivery is refreshed with the new content automatically.

name: cancel_task
label: Cancel Task
description: Cancel a task and remove it from the assignee's queue (lead can cancel any; assignee can cancel own). Pending queued deliveries are revoked automatically.

name: search_memory
label: Search Memory
description: Search your persistent memory (hybrid keyword+semantic retrieval over your private memories and the channel's shared team memories). Results may include: your task history, the TEAM CHRONICLE (团队编年史 = rolling log of everything the team finished), past SESSION COMPACTION SUMMARIES (会话压缩摘要 = conclusions from earlier context windows), monthly reflections (作业反思), and shared conventions. Use this ANY TIME you need prior context: before starting a task, when you suspect relevant past work exists, or when the injected memory hints/brief mention something you need details on. Pass a focused query describing what you want to remember.

query.description: What you want to recall, e.g. "数据库连接池配置结论" or "previous deployment checklist"

scope.description: Which memory domain to search: "auto" = your private + channel shared (default), "private" = only your own, "shared" = only channel-wide shared memories

name: save_memory
label: Save Memory
description: Persist a distilled, reusable insight into memory for future tasks. scope="private" saves to YOUR personal memory (only you recall it); scope="shared" saves to the CHANNEL shared memory visible to ALL teammates (use for conclusions, conventions, or knowledge the whole team benefits from — not task-specific minutiae). Distill before saving: title = short topic, content = the reusable conclusion. Use a stable dedup_key to update an existing memory instead of duplicating. NOTE: the platform already auto-archives task outcomes, team results, the team chronicle, and session compaction summaries — never save whole task logs or raw session transcripts.

title.description: Short topic title, e.g. "API 网关限流方案结论"

scope.description: "private" = your memory only; "shared" = channel-wide shared memory for all teammates

dedup_key.description: Stable key for idempotent update (same key overwrites instead of duplicating)

name: create_team_agent
label: Create Team Agent
description: (Lead only) Create a NEW worker agent and add it to your channel's team, on the fly. Use ONLY when all workers stay busy with a persistent backlog, or when a task clearly needs a specialist that doesn't exist yet — not for routine tasks the current team can handle. The new member starts idle, appears in list_team_agents immediately, and can receive dispatch_task assignments right away. Give it a clear name and a system_prompt describing its specialty.

name.description: Short, descriptive member name, e.g. "db-migrator" or "test-writer"

harness.description: Agent harness: "omp" = full LLM agent with native work tools (default, use this for real work), "mock" = scripted test agent, "claude" = claude harness

system_prompt.description: System prompt prefix defining this member's specialty, working style, and conventions (maps to its systemPromptPrefix config)

reason.description: Why this member is being added (shown to the user in the team event timeline)

name: update_team_agent
label: Update Team Agent
description: (Lead only) Update an existing team member (worker): rename it, revise its system prompt (e.g. to specialize or correct its behavior), or enable/disable it. The member's runtime reloads with the new config on its next assignment. You cannot update yourself.

agent_id.description: ID of the worker agent to update (from list_team_agents)

system_prompt.description: New system prompt prefix defining its specialty/conventions (optional)

enabled.description: true = activate member, false = disable member (disabled members receive no new tasks; default true)

reason.description: Why this change is made (shown in the team event timeline)

name: remove_team_agent
label: Remove Team Agent
description: (Lead only) Remove a worker from your channel's team. Its queued tasks are automatically re-dispatched to the remaining worker with the shortest queue (or failed for retry if it was mid-execution), so no work is lost — but the member's context is. Use ONLY for sustained idle surplus or persistent underperformance; never as an experiment, and avoid removing members with active work. You cannot remove yourself.

agent_id.description: ID of the worker agent to remove

reason.description: Why this member is removed (shown in the team event timeline)

name: refuse_task
label: Refuse Task
description: Reject a task assigned to you because it is outside your capability or work scope (wrong recipient, unrelated domain, or missing prerequisites). The task is marked FAILED with your reason and a rejection notice is immediately sent back to the dispatcher (task creator, or the channel lead), who should reassign it to a fitting member. Use this INSTEAD of silently ignoring the task or doing unrelated work; do NOT use it for tasks you are able to do, and do NOT use cancel_task for refusals.

task_id.description: ID of the task you are refusing (must be assigned to you)

reason.description: Why the task is out of your scope: capability mismatch / wrong recipient / prerequisites missing. Be specific so the dispatcher can reassign properly.

name: my_industrial_nodes
label: My Industrial Nodes
description: 列出你绑定的全部数采/数控节点及其物理含义(参数含义/单位/安全量程/活动配方工艺窗口/控制模式)。在进行任何工业操作前必须先调用本工具理解节点语义与设定规则。

name: dcw_control
label: DCW Control
description: 对绑定的数控节点下发工艺设定值(真实物理量纲)。仅限你有权控制的节点;设定值会被安全量程与活动配方工艺窗口联锁校验,越窗直接拒绝。手动确认模式下需等待用户批准,用户备注会随结果返回。下发前先调用 my_industrial_nodes 理解节点物理含义。

value.description: 目标设定值(真实物理量纲,如 ℃)

hypothesis.description: 本次调参假设(入优化记录档案):目标 + 预期效果 + 观察计划,如「提温 1℃ 预期张力上升 2%,5 分钟后复测」

task_id.description: 关联的优化任务 id(可选,入优化记录档案)

name: daq_query
label: DAQ Query
description: 从时序数据库检索你绑定的数采节点的历史/实时数据。支持按产线/产品/配方/时间窗/降采样多维过滤(产品/配方过滤基于逐样本打标,可精确取某批次数据);返回结果携带物理含义(参数语义/单位/量程/统计摘要/最近序列)。

node_id.description: 限定单个数采节点 id(缺省 = 全部绑定节点)

line_id.description: 按产线过滤(数据归属产线)

product_id.description: 按产品过滤(逐样本打标)

recipe_id.description: 按配方/批次过滤(逐样本打标)

last_minutes.description: 最近 N 分钟(缺省 30)

from_ms.description: 起始 epoch ms(与 to_ms 配合,优先于 last_minutes)

bucket_ms.description: 降采样桶宽 ms(长窗口建议 1000~60000)

name: dcw_judge
label: DCW Judge
description: 对你发起的优化记录(调控 step)落判定。keep=已验证经验(配方可标 lastGood);rollback=判定应回退(判定入册后必须再调 dcw_rollback 执行,判定不自动改 PLC);uncertain=证据不足保持观察。判定必须引用数采证据(daq_query 窗口数据),禁止无证据判定。

record_id.description: 优化记录 id(dcw_control 下发成功后返回)

reason.description: 判定理由(必须引用具体数值/时间窗证据)

name: dcw_rollback
label: DCW Rollback
description: 执行参数回退(经与下发相同的安全门控,回退本身入册可审计)。record_id=回退你自己发起的优化记录到其设定前值;node_id=单步撤销到最近稳定锚。回退后必须 daq_query 复测确认恢复。冷却期内同向重写/重复回退会被拒绝。

record_id.description: 要回退的优化记录 id(与 node_id 二选一)

node_id.description: 节点单步回退(撤销栈栈顶;与 record_id 二选一)

to.description: 可选:指定目标锚 id(dcw_journal 可查)

name: dcw_journal
label: DCW Journal
description: 查询参数变更史与优化记录(在册审计):谁/何时/从多少到多少/判定结论/假设声明。优化前先读史可避免重复试错;回退定位也在此查。

node_id.description: 限定数控节点 id(仅限自己绑定的节点)

limit.description: 返回条数上限(缺省 20,最大 100)

name: send_cross_channel_message
label: Cross-Channel Message
description: [Leader only] Send a message to the LEADER of another channel, so the two teams can collaborate without being siloed. The message lands directly in the target channel leader mailbox; that leader will read your request and act on it (dispatch tasks in their channel, gather info, etc.) and can reply to you via the mailbox. Params: to_channel_id accepts the target channel id OR its exact name; message is your request to the other leader (state your need, deadline and what you expect back); require_reply=true to demand a response. Only channel leaders may call this tool - workers will be rejected. When replying to a cross-channel request you received, use this same tool addressed to the requester channel.

to_channel_id.description: Target channel id or exact name (must be another channel, not your own)

message.description: Request text for the target channel leader: what you need, why, and what to return

require_reply.description: true = demand the target leader reply with their result/answer

name: list_other_teams
label: List Other Teams
description: [Leader only] Overview of the OTHER teams (channels) in this workspace: each team name, description, lead, its in-progress scenario tasks, recently completed tasks, and how many shared memories it has (shared_memories > 0 means searchable knowledge exists - use search_other_teams_memory with that team). Decision flow: found knowledge -> reuse it directly; relevant work in progress but no knowledge yet -> message their leader via send_cross_channel_message; nothing -> consider whether your request justifies starting collaboration. Workers cannot call this tool.

name: search_other_teams_memory
label: Search Other Teams Memory
description: [All members] Read-only search across the SHARED memory of other teams (channels) in this workspace - what other teams have learned/concluded/done. Use it to reuse existing knowledge instead of asking for it: if you find relevant results, apply them directly; if nothing relevant exists but the other team is working on it, ask your leader to message that team leader via send_cross_channel_message. Results are attributed to their team.

query.description: What to look for (keywords of the knowledge/conclusion)
